articles.title: Mallorca goalkeeper Iván Cuéllar injured after ‘large structure’ in canteen falls on him
articles.summary: 42-year-old suffers ‘serious head injury’ at training base. Cuéllar recovering in hospital after alarming accident. The Real Mallorca goalkeeper Iván “Pichu” Cuéllar suffered a serious head injury when “a large structure” at the club’s ⁠training ground canteen collapsed on him.
body: The club said Cuéllar was taken to hospital on Monday after the incident at ⁠the Ciutat Esportiva Antonio Asensio – also known ​as Son Bibiloni – ‌before the team’s scheduled training session.
Despite the alarm caused by the accident, Mallorca said the 42-year-old keeper was recovering well, as doctors monitored his condition and ruled out ‌further complications.

“This morning, Ivan ’Pichu’ Cuéllar suffered a serious head injury after a large ​structure, which formed part of the decor in the dining room at the Ciutat Esportiva collapsed,” the club said in a statement. “The ⁠player has been taken to hospital for treatment ​and ​will remain under observation ​for the next 24 hours.”

The Palma-based team, who are managed by former Espanyol forward Luis García, are preparing for Sunday’s Spanish second division match at Girona. Both teams were relegated from La Liga last season, and sit level on 13 points after seven games this term.

articles.title: Mancini refers to ‘double’ Manchester City contract and says it ‘isn’t my problem’
articles.summary: Coach alleged to have been paid for advisory work. City’s Soriano says club will fight to prove innocence. Roberto Mancini appeared to admit having “a double contract” while managing Manchester City, but insisted the club are not guilty after being found to have breached ­Premier League financial…
body: Mancini led City to their first ­Premier League title in 2012 during his four-year spell in Manchester. Now in charge of the Italy national team, he described the scandal surrounding the club as “not a problem that concerns me”.

One element of the case against City is an investigation into payment details for players and managers between 2009 and 2018. The German magazine Der Spiegel obtained evidence that Mancini doubled his base salary of £1.45m by advising a club in Abu Dhabi. “It’s not a problem that concerns me,” the 61-year-old said in Italy’s press conference before their Nations League match with Turkey on Monday.
“It’s not something new because every four or five years this comes up. Manchester City is not guilty and the fact of having a double contract isn’t my problem but theirs, probably.”

Mancini lifted the FA Cup as well as the Premier League during his time at City, the first trophies of Sheikh ­Mansour’s ownership, laying the foundations for future success. He left in 2013 after defeat against Wigan in the FA Cup final.

articles.title: O'Sullivan knocked out of Shenzhen Open
articles.summary: Seven-time world champion Ronnie O'Sullivan, world number one Zhao Xintong and defending champion Mark Williams lose on the opening day of the Shenzhen Open.
body: China's Jiang Jun, who is 64th in the world rankings, took the opening two frames before England's O'Sullivan levelled with breaks of 92 and 52.
Jiang reeled off the next three frames, sealing a famous 5-2 second-round win with a superb break of 108 to set up a meeting with Englishman Zak Surety.
Scott Donaldson stunned 2025 world champion Zhao by winning a final-frame decider.
Scotland's Donaldson, who is 65 places below Zhao in the rankings, compiled breaks of 77, 105, 50 and 62 as he came from 3-2 down.

articles.title: Defensive flux gives Tuchel headache but Alexander-Arnold could be remedy | Jacob Steinberg
articles.summary: Chopping and changing the back four has been a big feature for England this year and the Real Madrid man could be a solution. England ended 2025 protected by a shield of deceptive strength.
body: There is, of course, an irony to telling Tuchel to sort out his defence. Isn’t this what we wanted? England were limp and passive when they lost their World Cup semi-final against Argentina. At least the mindset was positive when Tuchel’s side opened their Nations League campaign with a sprightly but flawed 3-2 defeat against Spain last Saturday.

England played on the front foot and led after a thrilling surge. They had Spain on the ropes but it was unsustainable. Another lead was squandered against elite opposition, and although a lack of ambition was not to blame this time Tuchel still came away with tactical issues to solve before facing Czechia in Prague on Tuesday evening.

This is England’s second of four games during this break and they need a win to give themselves a proper shot of reaching the quarter-finals in March. Croatia await in Rijeka on Saturday and are likely to be tougher than a Czechia side who failed to make it out of a weak group at the World Cup.

articles.title: Giants trade for Vikings quarterback JJ McCarthy with Jaxson Dart ruled out for season
articles.summary: Minnesota will receive fifth-round pick for quarterback. McCarthy was first-round selection for Vikings in 2024. The New York Giants have acquired quarterback JJ McCarthy from the Minnesota Vikings for a 2027 fifth-round draft pick.
body: The Vikings announced the trade on Monday pending McCarthy passing a physical.
The Giants made the aggressive move days after Jaxson Dart had surgery on his left knee that will sideline him for at least the rest of the regular season.

Jameis Winston started and led the Giants to victory over Tennessee on Sunday, but the team failed to score a touchdown and had just 238 yards of offense. Coach John Harbaugh said after the game – and before the McCarthy trade was announced – that Winston would start again this Sunday against Arizona.

It’s unclear what New York’s QB situation will be moving forward after the addition of McCarthy. He was the 10th pick in the 2024 draft but lost the starting job in Minnesota to Kyler Murray and fell behind Carson Wentz on the depth chart. McCarthy’s career in Minnesota will go down as a failure. He was hampered by poor form, injuries and perceived immaturity during his time with the Vikings. He played just 10 games and so far has thrown more interceptions (12) than touchdowns (11) in the NFL.

articles.title: Ferguson retains Rangers dream but Bologna exit never close
articles.summary: Lewis Ferguson reveals "nothing was ever that close" on a move away from Bologna this summer amid reports of interest from Rangers but he does harbour ambitions of a return to his boyhood club.
body: Lewis Ferguson says he was never close to leaving Bologna this summer amid reports of interest from boyhood club Rangers.
But the Scotland midfielder, 27, does retain aspirations of an Ibrox return at some stage in his career.
Ferguson was released by Rangers at 14 and made his way to Serie A in 2022, via Hamilton Academical and Aberdeen.
He has captained Bologna since 2023 and led them to their first Coppa Italia in over 50 years in 2025.

articles.title: Dylan Harper plans to 'stay positive' no matter how Spurs use him
articles.summary: How Mitch Johnson plans to use second-year guard Dylan Harper this season after his dynamic performance in the playoff ranks as one of the biggest story lines heading into the start of training camp on Tuesday.
body: The Spurs coach didn't shed much light on the topic at media day Monday, but he did reveal he wants Harper and the team's other two rim-attacking guards, All-Star De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle, on the court together more this season.
"I see all three of them playing together," Johnson said. "I don't know the definition of 'a lot more,' but I think more than we did in the regular season (in 2025-26) for sure."

Harper came off the bench last season while Fox and Castle started, but many observers believe he should have a bigger role this season after his strong play against New York in the Finals. The No. 2 overall pick of the 2025 NBA Draft scored 21 points off the bench in Game 4 against the Knicks to become the youngest player at age 20 years and 100 days old to score 20-plus points in NBA history.
Harper followed up that performance by scoring 25 points in Game 5. The Spurs, however lost both games as they fell to New York in five games.

articles.title: Top-5 recruit Kellan Hall gets new prediction to Kentucky Football
articles.summary: As Kentuckians trade the dense, humid air of summer for crisp fall temps, football remains in the air around the Commonwealth. After several lackluster seasons, first-year head coach Will Stein has wasted no time igniting a fiery excitement within the passionate Kentucky Football fanbase.
body: Currently sitting with a 3-1 record and ranked 24th in the country in the latest AP Top 25 Poll, the Cats are starting to make noise nationally. The college football media is clearly beginning to take notice of Stein’s early success in the SEC, but more importantly, high-profile recruits are following along as well, setting the stage for potentially signing some top-tier talent in the next cycle and beyond.

One of the best 2028 players in high school football is Kellan Hall of Louisville Christian Academy, who holds offers from some of the top programs in America, including Ohio State, Georgia, Texas, Oregon, Michigan, Notre Dame, LSU, and Oklahoma, the latter being the presumed favorite for some time now.
However, heads turned on Monday when a prediction was entered for Hall favoring Kentucky.

Steve Wiltfong of Rivals changed his pick to favor UK with a 60% confidence level. Clearly, there was enough significance to the events of the weekend that it made Wiltfong feel strongly enough about putting Kentucky in the driver’s seat for Kellan Hall.

articles.title: Leics get partial points reprieve but stay in limbo
articles.summary: Leicestershire have eight points of their 27-point County Championship deduction reinstated but their Division One status remains in limbo.
body: The original penalty for breaching pitch regulations, relating to their win against Glamorgan in August, was announced on 16 September.

The amendment to the punishment comes after the Cricket Regulator raised with the Cricket Discipline Panel (CDP) whether the 19-point penalty imposed under the County Championship's playing conditions had been taken into account when making its original decision.
The Cricket Regulator said it had "raised this issue with the CDP and Leicestershire CCC in the interests of fairness and transparency".

A section of the County Championship's playing conditions state that teams charged with producing a pitch rated as poor or below average, and the CDP upholding the charge, would receive zero points from the fixture in question.

articles.title: Texas edge Colin Simmons snubbed for SEC weekly honors
articles.summary: Over the last 20 seasons, only one FBS player has recorded five sacks in a game against a ranked team — Texas Longhorns junior edge Colin Simmons in a big-time performance against the Tennessee Volunteers on Saturday.
body: The 20-17 win marked the eighth time in the last nine games that Simmons has recorded a sack. The five-sack effort in Knoxville tied the program record set by Shone Dronett against Texas Tech in 1990.
Simmons hasn’t just been a prolific sack artist for the Longhorns — he’s showed up in big games, recording 14.5 career sacks against ranked opponents, including at least one in seven straight games.

The total stats for Simmons were eight tackles (six solo), five sacks, one quarterback hurry, and one forced fumble. Pro Football Focus credited Simmons with 10 pressures, six sacks, and eight defensive stops.
Impressive, historic stuff for the 6’3, 246-pounder. Surely good enough to earn some SEC weekly recognition, right? Right?

articles.title: 'I didn't leave my family to lose' - LeBron ready for Philly success
articles.summary: NBA legend LeBron James has quashed retirement talk as he gets set for record-extending 24th season having signed with the Philadelphia 76ers this summer.
body: James will begin his expected final chapter at his inaugural camp with the 76ers.
He made the NBA world wait a few weeks before announcing his decision over the summer to join to Philadelphia on a two-year $8m (£6m) contract with a player option for next season.
If James wins a title in Philadelphia, the 76ers would be the fourth franchise to become champions with him on the roster.
James won two championships in Miami, one in Cleveland and one with the Los Angeles Lakers.
